title: Finite-cover augmentation for unbounded complexes with injective terms
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $r\geq0$, and $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X_{\mathrm{open}}$ a family with $\bigcup_iU_i=X$. Let $I$ be an arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] whose terms are injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. The actual section-to-total augmentation $\Gamma(X,I)\to T_U(I)$ of [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex] is a quasi-isomorphism. No boundedness or K-injectivity assumption is made.

source.place: Tag 08C1, proof: first paragraph using Tags 01EP and 01FM; parent Steps 1--2

proof.text: Apply injective_alternatingCech_row_augmentation to every term I.X n, using hI n. It supplies the actual horizontal single-row augmentation with its canonical zero-component formula and its quasi-isomorphism.

Prove finite horizontal support directly: negative columns vanish by extension by zero; for p≥r an increasing (p+1)-tuple in Fin r would contradict the cardinality bound for an injection. Products over the empty tuple type are zero. Thus only columns 0 through r-1 can survive, including the empty strip when r=0.

Apply quasiIso_of_finite_strip_row_augmentation with K=alternatingCechDoubleFunctor U I, A=the global-section complex, and a_n=alternatingCechZero U (I.X n). The actual augmentation has the required (0,n) inclusion formula definitionally. Combine the proved support bound with the row quasi-isomorphisms from Step 1.

proof_origin.place: First paragraph; explicit increasing-tuple row proof and finite-strip reduction by P3, 2026-10-13.
